text:
Flora ordered me, ah Fabio, to love but not desire her; obedient, confused, and stained, my care adores her beauty without desiring it.


The enamored understanding enjoys in the eternal spirit, imprisoned in the mortal cloister that treasures it, what human passion feels and mourns.


To love is to know burning virtue; to desire is interested will, coarse, discourteous, and mortal.


The body is earth, will be earth, and was nothing; the mind proceeds from God to eternity: I am eternal lover of an eternal beloved.

translation.title: Flora Ordered Me, Ah Fabio, to Love Her
